description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Delete a chatbot

Deletes a chatbot permanently and removes it from the voice engine. This cannot be undone, and any widget still embedded on a website stops working. Its integration links and knowledge entries are deleted with it, and so are the indexed knowledge documents that no other agent uses. The removal in the voice engine is attempted first, but a failure there does not stop the local deletion, so the chatbot always disappears from the account. This endpoint takes no request body.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: delete_chatbot
